findings.issue: `intervalIntegrable_realWindingIntegrand_window` obtains a.e. strong measurability of the integrand by first building it for `derivWithin γ (Icc c d)` (lines 126, 129-143) and then transferring to `deriv γ` through an a.e. congruence on `Ioo p q` (lines 144-153). Mathlib's `aestronglyMeasurable_deriv γ μ` / `stronglyMeasurable_deriv γ` hold for any `γ : ℝ → ℂ` with no hypotheses, so this ~25-line detour re-derives a located lemma; it also forces the extra hypothesis `hdw'` (line 117) and, with it, the `c d` piece parameters and `h_sub_cd` (lines 115-116), and the caller must supply `(hlipL t ht').continuousOn` / `(hlipR t ht').continuousOn` at lines 293 and 296.

summary: Prior findings (the duplicated sorted-crossing induction and the hand-rolled derivWithin set-congruence) are fixed. One reuse defect remains: the new window-integrability helper re-derives measurability of `deriv γ` through `derivWithin` continuity plus an a.e. congruence, where Mathlib's unconditional `aestronglyMeasurable_deriv` — already used elsewhere in this repo — gives it directly, dragging a superfluous hypothesis and caller arguments along.
